creation.prompt: Create ONE new pixel-art catalogue sprite of ARK: Survival Ascended's Enigmasaur, in its natural chameleon/theropod form (NOT disguised as another species). Input image 1 Rex and input image 2 Chalicotherium are STYLE AND FRAMING REFERENCES ONLY; do not alter them or copy their species. Match their detailed restrained retro game sprite technique: small crisp pixels, dark near-black outline, compact highlights and shading, isolated readable silhouette, side three-quarter view facing RIGHT, full body visible, single grounded neutral standing pose. Enigmasaur identity: bipedal theropod-like chameleon, squat compact head with a prominent rounded chameleon eye, short forearms with adjustable grasping claws, stronger bent hind legs, long thick curling chameleon tail, distinctive feathery spiny frills along neck and back. Jewel teal/turquoise and purple dorsal/frill accents, muted orange/copper underside and scattered scales, consistent with official creature concept; natural shaded game sprite, no glow/cloud/shape-shift effect. Frame at the same visual scale as these existing sprites with generous transparent margin and no clipping; feet close to the bottom, creature occupies roughly 140x130 of a 160x160 logical pixel canvas. Actual output 160x160 pixels if supported; otherwise preserve a clean coherent small logical pixel grid for nearest-neighbor export. Completely transparent background. No ground plane, shadow outside body, labels, logo, text, border, checkerboard, extra creatures, saddle or rider. This is original new fan sprite art, not a copy/paste of official promo artwork.

inputs.access: Indexed official concept and textual appearance reviewed; direct download returned 403. Not passed as a raster generation input.

creation.export: Generated RGBA source exported to the app's 160x160 format with nearest-neighbor sampling. Transparency preserved; no recoloring or modifications to existing sprites.

review.visual: Reviewed full sprite beside existing Rex and Chalicotherium at 160px on app-like gray, with nearest-neighbor enlargement. Bipedal chameleon silhouette, curled tail, frills and full limbs readable; no visible clipping. Static catalogue asset only; no animation claimed.
review.technical: PNG header/dimensions/hash, image routing, cache revision and preservation checks passed.
review.limitations: No full pixel-level comparison with official reference, reverse-image corpus, or comprehensive third-party artwork comparison. Generated/reference-derived character design rights remain unresolved; no blanket copyright clearance claimed.

deployment.assetPlacement: Standalone creature PNG alongside the existing archive. Original creature-art.zip and all original sprites untouched.

preserved: Guides, numerical calculations, rate workflow/manual fallback, interface/bubbles, icons/manifest/noindex, anonymous suggestions, source/contributor/license notices and free noncommercial public-beta audience retained.
